name: rtl-paragraph
note: An RTL (Hebrew) paragraph laid out by its computed direction, not LTR: the dir attribute feeds direction:rtl (css-writing-modes-4 §2.2), padding-inline-start resolves to padding-right, text-align:start resolves to right-align, and a width-constrained sibling block inside the RTL context sits flush right (§10.3.3). The rect deltas vs Chrome are all direction-driven.
